title: Locked final test of the validation-selected grounded generator
researchQuestion: Does validation-selected GLM-5.2 retain grounded answer quality, citation reliability, abstention, and operational reliability on evidence returned by the single locked retrieval-test execution?
hypothesis: GLM-5.2 will complete every evidence-bearing test case without truncation or provider mismatch and will retain the frozen human-quality guardrails.

selectionEvidence.judgeEligibility: disabled: neither GPT-5.4 Nano nor GPT-5.4 Mini satisfied the frozen calibration rule

lockedInputs.reasonForThirteenCalls: All twelve answerable cases and the single retrieval false positive carry evidence; the remaining eleven negatives use the frozen deterministic no-evidence response.

generationControls.noEvidencePolicy: deterministic abstention without a provider call

executionPolicy: Commit this protocol and the integrity-checking runner before one execution. A cache-preserving recovery may retry only technical failures and must retain the execution ledger; completed successful cases must never be regenerated.

humanConfirmation.primaryMetric: mean normalized grounded answer quality over the twelve answerable cases
humanConfirmation.decisionRule: Final generation confirmation requires the primary minimum and every guardrail. Automatic checks alone cannot establish semantic answer quality.

limitations: The final human review has one thesis-author reviewer and does not estimate inter-rater reliability.
The benchmark approval state is pending confirmation and AI-assisted rather than independently human-validated.
One negative receives an LLM answer because retrieval falsely supplied adjacent PostgreSQL evidence; this intentionally measures end-to-end abstention behavior.
The 900-token budget preserves the selected GLM comparison configuration; the separate 2,048-token runtime reliability result evaluated Gemini rather than GLM.
